text: Throughout ripening the wheels are rubbed every two days with a herbal brine, the Kräutersulz, which treats the rind as the cheese matures. Scalded only to about 40–42 °C and made in 6–8 kg wheels, it differs from the large, high-cooked Emmentaler and Gruyère.
